goal: Catch Guix build failures and broken signing dependencies in CI instead of at release time
Automatically verify release packages by running test suites on native target operating systems
reviewability: Ready for review now, though the author is expected to rebase and tidy up commits
agreement: Substantive support for catching release build issues early in CI (fanquake)
Initial objections about duplicate builds and caching were addressed and withdrawn (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it prevents release-time breakages by detecting Guix build bugs before merge
Saves maintainers manual verification effort when preparing releases
Expands test coverage to native target environments before binaries reach users
